title: DON'T LOVE ME
single_status: album track; earlier single status not yet reconciled

songwriting.textual_reading: The text links numbness and failed intoxication to a repeated request that a partner avoid attachment. A later verse frames this as habitual self-protection. The outro briefly reverses the command, creating an unresolved emotional contradiction.
